responsibility: This file implements GCC’s RTL shrink-wrapping optimizations that move function prologue and epilogue work away from the entry and exit blocks into only those paths that need stack-frame setup or save/restore components. It analyzes insns and liveness to determine where a stack frame is required, tries to move suitable register-setting insns to successor blocks, computes per-block and per-edge requirements for separate prologue/epilogue components, and emits target hook generated component sequences on blocks or edges. It is the main backend engine behind both ordinary and component-wise shrink wrapping, consuming CFG, DF liveness, and targetm.shrink_wrap hooks and producing modified RTL control flow with later prologue/epilogue placement deferred to the narrowed set of paths.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the backend implementation of shrink-wrapping itself, containing the RTL/dataflow analyses and prologue/epilogue placement algorithms, whereas gcc/shrink-wrap.h only exposes the entry points, stack-frame predicate, and enablement macro.
